'''1999 Coruscant Civil War''' was a Star Wars CCG open held in Syracuse, NY on 6 November 1999. [[Chris Terwilliger]] won it. It is known from Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d99">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-07-coruscant-civil-war-6-nov-99-syracuse-nyd99/ coruscant-civil-war-6-nov-99-syracuse-ny], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 7 November 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-07-coruscant-civil-war-6-nov-99-syracuse-nyd99/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 November 1999
* '''Site:''' Syracuse, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 26
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Terwilliger]]
